text: 12m ago 21.36 EDT ‘Dangerous’ and ‘unfair’ phone tower evidence should not have been permitted, court hears Patterson’s defence barrister, Veronika Drago , says the mobile phone tower evidence and the death cap mushroom sightings posted to the citizen science website iNaturalist should not have been permitted in the trial. She says “objective evidence” about cell towers was turned into “subjective evidence” by expert witness Dr Matthew Sorell. Sorrell, a digital forensics science expert, analysed Patterson’s mobile phone records for police and testified at the trial. Drago says the judge, Justice Christopher Beale , ruled that the cell tower evidence did not prove that Patterson visited Outtrim and Loch – where sightings of the lethal death cap mushrooms were posted online to the platform iNaturalist. Drago says Beale said it only showed the possibility visited the locations on the dates raised in the trial. She says the cell tower evidence was “dangerous” and “unfair”. During the trial, fungi expert Dr Thomas May told the court that he uploaded a post on iNaturalist on 21 May 2023 identifying death cap mushrooms in Outtrim. text: 20.14 EDT One Nation files three years of overdue financial returns Sarah Martin Pauline Hanson ’s One Nation party has complied with a request from the Queensland regulator to file three years of overdue financial returns. The party was sent a demand from the Office of Fair Trading (OFT) last month to submit the missing returns by 18 August or face compliance action. An OFT spokesperson told the Guardian on Wednesday that the returns were filed after business hours on Tuesday, ahead of the midnight deadline. They said: One Nation Queensland Division Inc has now lodged audited financial statements for the years 2022/2023, 2023/2024 and 2024/2025, as required by the Associations Incorporation Act 1981 . title: Tupac Shakur murder trial: ‘You better treat me as a hostile witness,’ Suge Knight associate testifies – as it happened
text: 20.23 EDT Closing summary The second day of the Tupac Shakur murder trial featured testimony from a wide range of witnesses, with a wide range of attitudes toward the legal process: Dr. Lisa Gavin, a medical examiner, reviewed the autopsy report and photos of Shakur’s body, and said that the evidence showed his death was a homicide. Some relatives of Shakur left the courtroom in response to the graphic photographs, while others looked away. Former Las Vegas police detective Dean O’Kelley described responding to the scene of Shakur’s shooting, spotting the bullet cases in the middle of the street, and using traffic cones to try to protect the crime scene until investigators arrived. “I told every attorney that tried to get me in here, you’d better treat me as a hostile witness,” James McDonald, an associate of Death Row Records co-founder Suge Knight, told the court, as he gave some details of reactions to Shakur’s shooting, but declined to answer other questions. “Me or anybody else bringing up the dead is wrong.”
author: Lois Beckett

title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
text: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election Image source, Reuters By Tabby Wilson Published 1 hour ago Former Ukrainian defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov has called for wartime elections, in what many see as the biggest challenge to Volodymyr Zelensky's presidency since war broke out with Russia in February 2022. "Democracy cannot be held hostage by Russia," said Fedorov, 35, in a video posted to YouTube on Tuesday, adding that Ukraine is fighting "precisely because we want to remain a free European state". Since Russia's invasion Ukraine has been under martial law, which means elections are suspended. Fedorov, who did not mention Zelensky by name in the video, was unexpectedly fired from his role as defence minister in late July, just six months after his appointment. Zelensky is yet to respond to the video from Fedorov, whose dismissal sparked protests across the country . During his tenure as defence minister, Fedorov was credited with energising the ministry, heading a drive against corruption and using data to analyse and try to improve performance on the front line. text: Реактивные «Герани» всё заметнее превращаются в промышленное средство давления на тылы противника. Если ещё недавно реактивные версии появлялись в налётах эпизодически, то уже год их доля в налётах стремительно растёт. В июле Reuters со ссылкой на украинские данные писал, что такие аппараты могли составлять до 20% российских ударных БПЛА в отдельных атаках. Уже в августе представитель Воздушных сил Украины Юрий Игнат заявил, что в некоторых налётах доля реактивных дронов достигала двух третей . Для Украины это, с одной стороны, новая проблема ПВО. Более высокая скорость сокращает время реакции и затрудняет работу дешёвых дронов-перехватчиков, которые успели стать одним из основных средств борьбы с обычными поршневыми «Геранями». Именно поэтому украинские и западные компании сейчас в ускоренном порядке создают более быстрые перехватчики. Но есть и обратная сторона. Чем чаще применяются реактивные «Герани», тем больше появляется материала для их изучения. Каждый новый эпизод применения увеличивает вероятность получения относительно целых обломков и позволяет постепенно накапливать статистику по разным версиям аппаратов: подтверждать состав комплектующих, сравнивать изменения конструк

title: Erin Patterson appeal live: mushroom murderer challenges convictions over fatal beef wellington lunch
text: 22.34 EDT Inadmissibility of mushroom photos and videos compromised Patterson's right to silence, court hears Drago is now turning to ground three of her client’s appeal. Patterson’s lawyers argued that the trial judge, Justice Christopher Beale , erred in ruling that photos and videos of mushrooms found on an SD card at her home were inadmissible. Drago says the SD card was found in Patterson’s study and contained photos of mushrooms taken in 2020. Some photos were posted on Facebook. Drago says some of the mushrooms appear to be foraged mushrooms. She says the prosecution wanted to use the photos in their case to show Patterson had an “enduring interest” in wild-growing mushrooms. But Beale ruled that the photos were inadmissible because they were too temporally remote from the circumstances of the case. As a reminder, the beef wellington lunch occurred in July 2023. Drago says Beale’s ruling that the photos of mushrooms were inadmissible meant Patterson was compelled to give evidence, compromising her right to silence as a defendant.

text: Россия обретает святых, враг — поклоняется палачам В Архангельском соборе Кремля обретены мощи Дмитрия Донского — победителя Куликовской битвы, объединителя русских земель. Дмитрий Иванович (1350–1389) укрепил Московское княжество, построил белокаменный Кремль и в 1380 году разгромил Мамая на Куликовом поле, сокрушив миф о непобедимости Орды. В 1988 году его канонизировали как воплощение самопожертвования ради народа и веры. Место его погребения было известно всегда: с 1389 года князь покоился под спудом, в закрытом саркофаге под плитой с надгробием, — но сами мощи как святыня веками оставались недоступны для освидетельствования и поклонения. В июле 2026 года при реставрации, вызванной проседанием плит, саркофаг вскрыли — и обстоятельства поразили даже специалистов: захоронения Донского и его отца оказались расположены не друг под другом, как считалось столетиями, а отдельно. На крышке саркофага самого князя обнаружились трещины — ещё немного, и мощи могли быть повреждены. Экспертиза подтвердила подлинность останков, и Патриарх Кирилл благословил поместить их в ковчеги для поклонения. Мощи будут представлены на Крестном ходе 6 сентября. "Democracy cannot be held hostage by Russia," said Fedorov, 35, in a video posted to YouTube on Tuesday, adding that Ukraine is fighting "precisely because we want to remain a free European state". Since Russia's invasion Ukraine has been under martial law, which means elections are suspended. Zelensky is yet to respond to the video from Fedorov, whose dismissal sparked protests across the country . Иногда он начинает скрывать экран телефона, нервничает при появлении взрослых, быстро закрывает приложения, переводит чаты в режим очистки переписок по истечению заданного времени, либо в мессенджере уже есть чаты с очищенной перепиской. title: Erin Patterson appeal live: mushroom murderer challenges convictions over fatal beef wellington lunch
text: 22.34 EDT Inadmissibility of mushroom photos and videos compromised Patterson's right to silence, court hears Drago is now turning to ground three of her client’s appeal. Patterson’s lawyers argued that the trial judge, Justice Christopher Beale , erred in ruling that photos and videos of mushrooms found on an SD card at her home were inadmissible. Drago says the SD card was found in Patterson’s study and contained photos of mushrooms taken in 2020. Some photos were posted on Facebook. Drago says some of the mushrooms appear to be foraged mushrooms. She says the prosecution wanted to use the photos in their case to show Patterson had an “enduring interest” in wild-growing mushrooms. But Beale ruled that the photos were inadmissible because they were too temporally remote from the circumstances of the case. As a reminder, the beef wellington lunch occurred in July 2023. Drago says Beale’s ruling that the photos of mushrooms were inadmissible meant Patterson was compelled to give evidence, compromising her right to silence as a defendant.
author: Adeshola Ore
